title: Migration 007 skips required indexes when media tables already exist
reasoning: The migration has idempotent index-existence checks, but those checks are nested inside the table-creation branches. If media_feeds or media_items already exists without one of these indexes, for example after a partial/manual migration, revision 007 does not create the missing indexes. The media_feeds URL uniqueness constraint is especially important because missing it allows duplicate feed rows that the intended schema would reject.
reproduction: Create media_feeds without ix_media_feeds_url, set the database before revision 007, then run the migration. Because media_feeds already exists, the unique URL index is never created.
recommendation: Move index creation outside the table-existence blocks so each index is created whenever it is missing, regardless of whether the table was created in this migration run.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked migration tests cover partially existing media tables or assert final indexes after revision 007.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a migration test with pre-existing media_feeds and media_items tables missing indexes, run revision 007, and assert ix_media_feeds_url, ix_media_items_feed_id, ix_media_items_guid, and ix_media_items_status exist.
